items.note: K1 states the eight-row schedule, scratch-independence and the three-stage exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restoration; K1.1-K1.4 follow the proof at 741-765 (net change (JV+RG)x, bit and complex coefficient cases, the three stages). The neighbour counts z_b, z_c and wire counts W_b, W_c (767-783) are not given, but they are not part of the lemma.
Frames per vertex, common frame per gate, edge operator D_vD_u^{-1}, the invariant argument via R-linearity and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} all match 793-826.

The lemma's content is stated correctly (comparable labels, only central 3->4 edges decrease by h, L=Ich, budget Wm-2N+2L, ratios 100/539 and 101/539), but K3.1 assigns the pairing |S cap T|-1 to the F_2 dot product as well, which holds only for the rational form. The derivation omits the actual label construction: the stage spaces A, B, P, Q, the stage transitions (911-937), the gate-label table eq:motif-labels and the residual table (1022-1043). It keeps only the side-edge nesting, B=0 at stage 1 and the telescoping.

Projections on gates and sinks, -P_{U_a} on sources, rank of P_V-P_U equal to the dimension change, the N rank-one source exceptions (2P_{U_a}), s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b<W_bm and the endpoint identity I_m all follow 1156-1172; the shear H<-H+D on every role appears in K7.2.3.

Weight additivity mod 4, odd weight, the translation kernel aI+bX_v, the count s_c=W_cm-2N+2L_c and the X_a->Y_a exception with Z_{a,k} and i^{27k} follow 1231-1315. The plan never says why the other roles get C^{tensor m}: the zero label has frame I and the full label has frame C^{tensor m} because q_F(x)=wt(x) (1287-1289). It also leaves the k-column tensoring implicit.

L/N<1/2 gives deficits N-2L_b and 2N-2L_c. The exact eta_b, eta_c exceed 20*2^{-50}, and log m<20 gives m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-eta), so s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}. This is exactly the route at 1319-1346.

S1 lists the four elementary operations correctly. S2 gives the controlled shift and unit scaling with only a one-line mechanism (split and merge in the opposite order), not the paper's derivation. Its claim omits the condition that the offset be preparable in b^{O(1)} time (it appears only in the quote), as well as the prime radix and the coefficient restrictions.

The factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2, the O(V) triangular transforms via controlled shifts and the one-interchange realization of each one of Pi match 1375-1447. The statement omits that the shear is over Z/q^b for a fixed odd prime q. The derivation omits choosing that prime to avoid every denominator and diagonal numerator, so the rational factors specialize and stay invertible (1413-1423).

Cyclic row split into W role streams of volume V/W, frames Phi_M with edge shears done by recursive interchanges, Phi_{I_m} endpoint, the three-shear interchange, s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum and the LIFO parking schedule all follow 1491-1615.

Top rho digits as row field, padding to R'<2R, base-m decomposition with a_j<m, the O(Ve^tau) sum and binary padding to [q^e] reproduce 1649-1735. Unequal widths (peeling one bit) appear in S8.1.11 and S9.3.8.

C identities, conjugation by P_M, one child per residual vector on slot h, inverse children via (-i)^f Z C Z, the elimination count m(m-1)+3m, exactly s_c children and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D all match 1814-1940.

The eight parity-controlled additions, guard interval and bad set, delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, the T_0S_0^{-1} permutation of B, swaps around rotations, the radix-sort repair and the time bound with o(1) extra terms follow 2013-2207. The application to row additions is in K8.1.4 and K8.3.2.

Individual kernels O(Ve), node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), q_0 row chunks, row split giving V/W children, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1), internal and leaf sums, and the base-m pieces giving O(d^{lambda'}) all match 2253-2448.

Depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E with E=64(W+m+1)^3, the bound 8B^2d^{nu+1}, the guard widths p+Delta and Delta+3 with Delta=o(p), the O(Vd^{lambda'}) time, and the single truncation with error <sqrt2 2^{-p} follow 2450-2758.

Character cancellation via the shift k->k+t/2^{v+1}, decimation in frequency, bit-reversed storage B_t, grouped rounds H then J_E, the layout L (prefix moves and chunk exchanges), the per-term costs, the J_E/Q_p commutation and the operators LBF^- and F^+B^{-1}L^{-1} all match the paper.

B_0=2^{4p}, the evaluation bound, separation |h_j|<B_0/2, signed encoding carries in {-1,0}, centered extraction with carries in {0,1}, negacyclic reduction |H_j|<=r2^{2p}, truncation and O(rp log(rp)) follow 3233-3368.
Normalization via F^-(f*g)=M(F^-f)(F^-g) and F^+F^-=I/M, P(LBu,LBv)=LBP(u,v), the error chain 2delta+eta then 3delta+eta scaled by M, and the cost are those of 3414-3495.

Gaussian maps, N=CTD with ||N-I||<1/2 and Neumann inversion, the 2^{-2alpha^2} normalization, the quoted ordered maps and their errors, the zero-error selector, both permutations retained instead of sorted, tensoring, the line costs and the axis-exposure cost all follow 3576-3897.

Chirp periodicity and coefficient identity for QF_t, F_q^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F_q^+, RF^+R=F^+, commutation with pointwise products, the normalized convolution rule giving (u*v)/S^2, and conjugation all match 3938-3988.

The fixed rationals, sizes b, p, d, K and T, the axis lengths r/2 and r, the prime-interval lemma with eta=1/(4d), Bernoulli for T/2<S<T, alpha^4 theta_i>p and the n^{o(1)} prime search all reproduce 4004-4179.

Isomorphism via the order of the image of x, the triangular formula with mu_iP_i=1, padding scan, update order i=d..1, bijections preserving the valid set, prefix-controlled shifts and the O(Tpd^2(1+ell^tau)) cost follow 4204-4296.

Well-definedness, diagonal isometric isomorphism, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, the identity M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T, the computed twist sequence and twist errors below 4 all match the paper.
Chirp transform, source transform with exact counterpart 2^gamma B_0 QF_t A=RF_s and its conjugate, digit scaling by 2^{-b-2}, the six steps and the role of the two factors S follow 4415-4544.

The error chain E_ring<5TL, 6TL, 8TL, E_s=9 2^gamma TL, (2E_s+2), (3E_s+2), E_w<28 2^gamma T^2L, the final bound <1/2, rounding and the carry invariant follow 4546-4806. S9.6.1's norm bound omits its condition (listed under errors).

The seven normalized costs and their powers of p, the margins g_1..g_7 with min 2^{-181}=2kappa, setup and exceptional sorting o(V), absorption of log powers by p^kappa, and the schoolbook cutoff match 4808-4995.

S0 says the bound disproves the n log n optimality conjecture, but no step gives the content: no eventual lower bound T_A(n)>=c_A n lg n is formulated, and no step shows that a liminf of zero refutes it.

errors.says: For triple indicators <t_S,t_T>=|S cap T|-1, both for the rational form I-J/9 (bit network) and for the dot product on F_2^h (complex network); the K3 method likewise speaks of 'pairing |S cap T|-1'.
errors.paper: The formula <t_S,t_T>=|S cap T|-1 with <t_T,t_T>=2 is for the rational form I-J/9 only. Over F_2 with the ordinary dot product t_T.t_T=1 and t_S.t_T=|S cap T| mod 2, so the complex neighbours (even intersection) are orthogonal for a different reason. The conclusions (nondegenerate lines, orthogonal neighbours) are right.

errors.says: Every nonzero binary residual is nonalternating because 'it contains a norm-one coordinate vector'.
errors.paper: The norm-one vector is built by tensoring norm-one vectors from each factor: the triple indicators spanning P and Q, and coordinate units in B, triple complements, Q^perp or full spaces. It is placed in one orthogonal summand, so in general it is not a coordinate vector of F^{tensor 3}.

errors.says: Normalized ring convolution has error E_ring<5TL and norm below .701, stated without condition.
errors.paper: The .701 norm margin holds when one operand has norm at most .7; the error bound E_ring=M(3L+2)<5TL holds in general.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}): the two exchange networks with frames and labels (K1-K5), the rank saving tau=1-2^{-50} (K6), the interchange recurrence (K7) and the simultaneous layer (K8). These feed the synthetic transforms, ring convolution, resampling and chirp, assembly, exact recovery and the cost table (S6-S10), almost always with faithful sub-steps. It thins out at the base of the saving. The network sizes (h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3, m=h^3, the wire counts) are never given. The label construction is reduced to its conclusions, with no stage spaces A, B, P, Q or gate-label table. The complex interface does not say why the zero and full labels give I and C^{tensor m} at the endpoints.

steps.note: K1 fully reconstructs the scalar exchange network: (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored, via the eight-row schedule and three stages. But h=100, data indexed by triples of triples, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 never appear, although N and m are used later. Conservatively mentioned, since half the defining content is absent.
Common frame per gate commuting with pointwise gates, the operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and each edge paying only D_vD_u^{-1} with free intermediate frames are all stated.

Nondegenerate subspaces of F^{tensor 3} from triple indicators, comparable labels on every edge, and the only decreasing edges being central wires 3->4 each losing h (P tensor F) are stated. The explicit label table is not given, and K3.1 misattributes the pairing formula to the F_2 form.
K4.1 gives rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested nondegenerate labels; K4.2 gives the N source exceptions 2P_{U_a} of rank one.
K3.3 gives L=Ich and the sum of absolute changes Wm-2N+2L via telescoping and the source and sink sums; K4.3 gives s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, giving the deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0 and hence s<Wm.
K4.4 gives P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m and the identity on other roles; K7.2.3 turns it into Phi_{I_m}, i.e. H<-H+D on every row, scratch rows included.
A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, triangular parts in O(V), one interchange per pivot so exactly a interchanges, done recursively on each edge, giving exactly s recursive calls per node.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, and the geometric sum giving F_k=O(e^tau) are all stated.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central saving almost completely: frames, labels, rank equals dimension change, the budget, the strict deficit from L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity, rank-to-recursive-call conversion and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50} (C2-C9). The weak point is C1. The exchange network itself is reconstructed, but its size parameters h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never stated, although the plan uses N and m throughout.
